_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); oilfield services signals

pit_profile.why: Baker Hughes: 'Baker Hughes Incorporated is a Delaware corporation engaged in the oilfield services industry'; 'The primary driver of our business is our customers’ capital and operating expenditures dedicated to exploring, and drilling for, and developing and producing oil and natural gas'; 'Our business is cyclical and is dependent upon our customers’ expectations for future oil and natural gas prices, future economic growth, hydrocarbon demand and estimates of future oil and natural gas production'; 'We operate in a highly competitive environment, which may adversely affect our ability to succeed'; 'In addition, demand for oil and natural gas could be impacted by environmental regulation or carbon taxes targeting reduction of greenhouse gas emissions or the cost for carbon capture and sequestration related regulations' (its own FY2008 10-K): revenues and earnings that follow customers' drilling and production spending through the commodity cycle, by the company's own account; no disruption theme is live for an oilfield services company, so the greenhouse-gas wording stays here

classification.quality_note: Baker Hughes: 'Baker Hughes Incorporated is a Delaware corporation engaged in the oilfield services industry'; 'The primary driver of our business is our customers’ capital and operating expenditures dedicated to exploring, and drilling for, and developing and producing oil and natural gas'; 'Our business is cyclical and is dependent upon our customers’ expectations for future oil and natural gas prices, future economic growth, hydrocarbon demand and estimates of future oil and natural gas production'; 'We operate in a highly competitive environment, which may adversely affect our ability to succeed'; 'In addition, demand for oil and natural gas could be impacted by environmental regulation or carbon taxes targeting reduction of greenhouse gas emissions or the cost for carbon capture and sequestration related regulations' (its own FY2008 10-K): revenues and earnings that follow customers' drilling and production spending through the commodity cycle, by the company's own account; no disruption theme is live for an oilfield services company, so the greenhouse-gas wording stays here. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.06x; -48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.48; conservative 2yr +166%.

summary: BHI (retrospective, 2010-01-22) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.06x (50.3% downside to Bear $22 / +841.9% upside to Bull $417) | Adj composite 1.70 vs market 1.22: gap +0.48 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | -48% above the EPP floor $85 (16x FY09E $5.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: +166.2% total (+83.1%/yr) | At 8.4x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $59 sits at or below the BASE case; North America revenue -37.7% and revenue outside North America -16.7% in Q3 2009, forward revenues -25.8% (no Q4 2009 revenue guide, Q3 2009 revenue as reported); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
